title: AGPL-3.0 viral license via sieve-rs not documented outside a Cargo.toml comment
description: crates/sieve/Cargo.toml has: '# sieve-rs is AGPL-3.0-only — intentional, approved by project owner'. Any binary that links usenet-ipfs-sieve is AGPL-licensed. usenet-ipfs-smtp links sieve. AGPL requires operators running the binary as a network service to provide source to their users. Scenario: a contributor adds features to usenet-ipfs-smtp thinking it is MIT/Apache; they are actually submitting AGPL code. A user deploys it commercially without reading Cargo.toml. The information is currently in exactly one place (an inline comment) where no external contributor or user will find it. Fix: document in README, CLAUDE.md, and the crate's own lib.rs doc comment that usenet-ipfs-smtp is AGPL-licensed due to the sieve-rs dependency.
